kind: independently initialized one-day execution stress episodes; never compound returns
universe: fixed 30 Shenzhen 000xxx names selected on March 2026 prior liquidity; not a certified all-market historical universe
signal: raw close[last]/close[first]-1 on previous 21 official sessions; unadjusted debugging signal, corporate actions can affect ranks
warmup_missing: carry previous observed close only for positive authorized suspension evidence, all imputations retained
episode_initialization: 50% bottom-half equal reference-notional existing sellable inventory + residual cash; target top-half 100%; freeze rounded shares across all models
reference_price: latest valid preopen L2 pre_close strictly before 09:30; evidenced suspension without preopen quotes uses prior observed official close flagged stale
corporate_actions: episodes initialize at current-day pre_close, no overnight entitlement or account carry; not a corporate-action-complete strategy backtest
missing_eod_mark: only evidenced suspended names may use unchanged episode initial mark; demand never removed
missing_data_policy: exclude entire planned episode if any fixed-pool name lacks L2 and has no suspension evidence; never count missing observations as zero market liquidity
sensitivity: max capital on every episode: snapshot refresh, 3s and 10s propagation
refresh: conservative per day/per price cumulative simulated consumption subtracted from observed depth
funding: sufficient; actual holdings and sellable constraints retained
daily_archive: D+1 archive source, no versioned production PIT guarantee
market_environment: positive historical suspension evidence blocks stale-book fills, retained separately with original known_at/recorded_at even when learned after the session; never used to alter signals or demand; not a contemporaneously known strategy input
formal_factor: not connected: authorized factor-folder contract not provided
sample_unit: 13 correlated market episodes and 390 stock-date opportunities before scenario/capital repetitions; descriptive quantiles, no independence claim

metric_weights.completion: all frozen target shares times reference price, including unfilled demand
metric_weights.slippage: filled shares times reference price; no fills means missing slippage
metric_weights.quote_diagnostics: executed notional on valid source and execution books; coverage reported separately; non-additive descriptive ratios
metric_weights.episode_distribution: one EOD observation per independently initialized date; descriptive quantiles, no compounding or independence inference

provenance_label_correction: 23 Aug31 L2 valuation-mark records for suspended 000635 at 15:00 were relabelled from official_close to stale_evidenced_suspension_mark; decoded CSV content otherwise exactly unchanged. Current code emits the corrected label directly.
desktop_replay_validation: Aug31, 1m capital, 5 models: all 41 serialized account/execution tables exactly equal to the corresponding full-study baseline, including corrected stale-mark provenance.
test_suite: 72 passed; includes causal source/depth/account checks, export trust boundaries and retrospective closing-state evidence.
